capabilities.description: Google Workspace Gmail API for reading, drafting, labeling, and sending email on behalf of a user.

pricing.free_tier: Included subject to Google API quota and Gmail sending limits.

usage_terms.license: Google API Services User Data Policy and Gmail sending/anti-abuse policies apply.
usage_terms.notes: Automated email sending is high-risk; local policy should distinguish draft creation from sending.

data_governance.retention: User mailbox retention follows Google account/workspace policy.
data_governance.lock_in_notes: Email is portable via IMAP/Takeout, but labels and thread state are Gmail-specific.

metrics.name: workspace_email_api_fit
metrics.benchmark: Official Gmail API supports read, draft, label, and send workflows

sla.rate_limit: 1,200,000 quota units per minute per project; method costs vary, drafts.send costs 100 units.

approval.human_readable: Agents may draft freely under policy; sending or destructive mailbox actions should require approval.

operational_constraints.policy_notes: Email send is a user-visible external action and should be treated differently from mailbox search.

provenance.notes: Verified quota-unit limit and method-unit examples from official Gmail API quota docs.
